race.comment: QUEDJINUP (10) raced on the same day as PROFIT MOTIVE when first-up and ran nearly identical splits to the early fave. She flashed home strongly from the back and while this is tougher, there's less separating them to what the market suggests. Likely to get back but watch for her late in the race. PROFIT MOTIVE (14) didn't jump favourite on resumption but won like an absolute rocket with Watson barely asking for an effort. She looks an exciting filly and this is the logical progression. Ran good splits in the process first-up and can work through the grades. TREASURED LEGACY (8) comes through Open 3YO events, bumping into the handy Roger last start after a Bunbury CL3 win prior. Has enough early speed to offset the tricky gate and she can make her presence felt. ROYAL REFLECTION (13) missed as a deep odds-on pop last start at Bunbury but looks a handy type. Wouldn't surprise. CASSANDRA (12) should be better for the last start effort and is worth including.
